work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Apostolic letter CCCLVII erects the territory of interior Africa bounded by Egypt, Abyssinia, Guinea, Tripoli, Tunis, Algiers and the Mountains of the Moon into a vicariate apostolic; intitulation, ad perpetuam formula, narrative, motu proprio erection, non obstantibus clause and dating clause survive. Issuer evidence: GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF67082–67082; the source dating clause at LF67142–67145 reads: _Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die tertia aprilis millesimo octingen- tesimo quadragesimo sexto, pontificatus Nostri anno decimo sexto, Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
